test_inputs.explanation: The execution trace only shows repeated navigation to the Magento admin Orders grid URL with all actions marked as unknown, so no concrete dropdown selections are visible. To provide realistic, working test data aligned with the tool description ('Actions' mass actions on the Orders grid and optional Status filter), a common, valid mass action value is 'Cancel', and the safest generic status filter value is 'Any' (which matches the description as not narrowing by status). These values conform to the expected usage of the tool and should work to test it, even though the exact original selections are not revealed in the log.
